B20Created(address,uint8,string,string,u.details: `variantEventParams` carries variant-specific immutable identity data, ABI-encoded      and prefixed with a version byte. Empty for ASSET; for STABLECOIN,      `abi.encode(B20StablecoinEventParams)` with `currency`.`decimals` mirrors the value chosen at creation: configurable in      `[B20Constants.MIN_ASSET_DECIMALS, B20Constants.MAX_ASSET_DECIMALS]` for ASSET      (from `B20AssetCreateParams.decimals`); hardcoded to `6` for STABLECOIN.

createB20(uint8,bytes32,bytes,bytes[]).details: Reverts with `NonPayable` when ETH is attached to the call.Reverts with IActivationRegistry.FeatureNotActivated when the variant feature is not activated.Reverts with `InvalidVariant` when `variant` is outside the `B20Variant` range.Reverts with `UnsupportedVersion` when the leading `version` byte in `params` is unrecognized for `variant`.Reverts with `MissingRequiredField` when a required string field is empty (e.g. stablecoin `currency`).Reverts with `InvalidCurrency` when a stablecoin `currency` is non-empty but contains a non-`A`-`Z` byte.Reverts with `InvalidDecimals` when an asset `decimals` is outside `[B20Constants.MIN_ASSET_DECIMALS, B20Constants.MAX_ASSET_DECIMALS]`.Reverts with `TokenAlreadyExists` when a token already exists at the derived address.Reverts with `InitCallFailed` (or the bubbled inner reason) when any entry in `initCalls` reverts.Each `initCall` executes on the new token within the creation (bootstrap) window, during which      factory-originated calls bypass the token's role gates and its transfer-side policy gates      (`TRANSFER_SENDER_POLICY`, `TRANSFER_RECEIVER_POLICY`, `TRANSFER_EXECUTOR_POLICY`) — so admin-gated      setup (e.g. `grantRole`, `updatePolicy`, `updateSupplyCap`) and bootstrap transfers succeed without      the factory holding any role. The bypass is deliberately NOT total:      - `MINT_RECEIVER_POLICY` is ALWAYS enforced, including for factory-originated mints, so new supply is        never issued to a policy-denied recipient even at creation. An `initCalls` bundle that sets a        restrictive `MINT_RECEIVER_POLICY` and then mints to a non-authorized account reverts        `PolicyForbids(MINT_RECEIVER_POLICY, ...)` (bubbled out of `createB20`).      - Pause is never bypassed. It defaults to nothing-paused at creation, so a start-paused        configuration must sequence its `pause(...)` call last among the `initCalls`.      - Token invariants (supply-cap math, balance accounting) are never bypassed.      The window closes when `createB20` returns; the factory retains no persisted access.

params.initCalls: Bootstrap calls invoked on the new token after identity is sealed.
params.params: ABI-encoded variant-specific creation struct, leading with the version byte.
params.salt: Caller-chosen salt for deterministic address derivation.

returns.token: The address of the newly created token.

params.variant: Variant of the token whose address is being predicted.

returns._0: Whether `token` matches the B-20 address prefix.

InitCallFailed(uint256).notice: One of the `initCalls` reverted. The factory bubbles the underlying revert reason         where the call returns one; this error wraps empty reverts.

InvalidCurrency(string).notice: The stablecoin `currency` was non-empty but contained a non-`A`-`Z` byte.

InvalidDecimals(uint8).notice: The asset `decimals` was outside the allowed inclusive range         `[B20Constants.MIN_ASSET_DECIMALS, B20Constants.MAX_ASSET_DECIMALS]`.

MissingRequiredField(string).notice: A required string argument was the empty string.

NonPayable().notice: ETH was attached to a call targeting a nonpayable factory selector.

TokenAlreadyExists(address).notice: A token already exists at the deterministic address derived from         `(variant, msg.sender, salt)`. Caller must use a different salt.

UnsupportedVersion(uint8,uint8).notice: The leading `version` byte in `params` does not match any known encoding for the requested variant.

B20Created(address,uint8,string,string,u.notice: Emitted once per `createB20` invocation, after the token's identity is sealed         and before any `initCalls` are dispatched.

createB20(uint8,bytes32,bytes,bytes[]).notice: Creates a B-20 token of the given `variant` at the deterministic address derived         from `(variant, msg.sender, salt)`, then dispatches each entry in `initCalls` on         the new token. Emits `B20Created`.

getB20Address(uint8,address,bytes32).notice: Returns the deterministic address `createB20` would assign for `(variant, sender, salt)`. Never reverts.

isB20(address).notice: Returns whether `token` was created by this factory, recovered from the address prefix. Never reverts.

isB20Initialized(address).notice: Returns whether `createB20` has run to completion at `token`. Flips exactly once,         the moment the creating `createB20` call returns. Never reverts.

userdoc.notice: Singleton factory precompile for creating B-20 tokens of any variant. A single         entry point `createB20` dispatches on a `B20Variant` discriminator; variant-specific         arguments are ABI-encoded into `params` with a leading `version` byte.
